review.eventDescription: One source-visible customer review (row keys review_id, rating, title, text, author, country, date_text, verified, helpful_votes, variant, url): $5 per 1,000 reviews. Product-page samples only, not full history or a guaranteed count. UK examples are verified; current US tests hit a sign-in wall. Set maxReviewsPerProduct to a positive N to cap review rows after filters; 0 means all visible reviews. Not charged: filtered or duplicate reviews, unknown or blocked ASINs, and status rows. The optional product row is a separate event. No start fee; proxy and compute are included. The run stops at the Apify maxTotalChargeUsd run limit.

product.eventDescription: One product rating summary (row keys asin, title, brand, rating, ratings_count, 5_star_pct through 1_star_pct, price, currency, availability, image, features, reviews_visible): $3 per 1,000 products. Fields are null when absent from the source. Delivered once per ASIN and marketplace when includeProductRow is true (default); set false for review rows only. An accessible product with no reviews may still have this paid summary. Blocked or unknown products, duplicates and status rows are not charged. No start fee; proxy and compute are included.
